verdict.rationale: Square documents its own Invoices API (square-docs-18), and its MCP service catalog lists invoices (square-supp-mcp-tools), so first-party invoicing exists. The evidence is only a bare title and a catalog entry, though: nothing describes hosted invoice pages, paying an invoice online, or automatic reminders. The general online-payment methods (cards, ACH, Cash App) are not tied to invoices in the evidence. Missing for 10: evidence of hosted invoice pages, online payment linked to invoices, automatic reminder scheduling, finance-ops UI workflow, independent corroboration.
